adobe.note: Licensed optional stack retained alongside the free craft tools; a scene's engineHint or MOTION_STUDIO_EDITORIAL_ENGINE selects which specialist/editorial engine a production uses.

notes: Dual stacks: the free craft tools (FilmCraft + EffectCraft) are the default engines; the licensed Adobe stack stays fully supported for subscribed hosts.

FilmCraft and EffectCraft are open source (MIT / Apache-2.0); install from GitHub releases or getartcraft.com. They expose headless MCP servers over stdio via their CLIs (scripts/craft-mcp-launcher.mjs).
Both craft tools are alpha: Motion Studio gates every mutation behind explicit producer approval.
Adobe applications are licensed products; installers must use the user's Creative Cloud account and UI. Adobe MCPs run locally over stdio with read-only/inspect-only onboarding.
No public network listener is enabled; all MCP traffic is local stdio.
